# Bundled third-party mods

These Lua mods are bundled unmodified and installed (enabled) the first time
Aerospace Client starts. Players can disable or delete them in the Mods screen;
a deleted mod is not reinstalled.

| Mod | Source | Release | Commit | Licence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sodium (Lua port) by UserArham | https://github.com/UserArham/Sodium-Written-In-Lua | 0.5.0 (latest release) | `26b4f1bc42346699737b87ccedf23e63acdfa78a` | Apache-2.0 (`sodium/LICENSE`) |
| Lithium (Lua port) by UserArham | https://github.com/UserArham/Lithium-Written-In-Lua | 0.1.3 (latest release) | `9f924aaba2e970ac973adb510833e40265b6c12c` | Apache-2.0 (`lithium/LICENSE`) |

The files are taken from each release's tagged source. Sodium's 0.5.0 file
still says `version: 0.3.6` in its header; it is the file as tagged.
